answer.finalSql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") AS "year", SUM("daily_new_deaths") AS "covid_deaths" FROM "86440223-249d-4b3d-9be4-159a4e615e0a" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MAX("date")) - 1 FROM "86440223-249d-4b3d-9be4-159a4e615e0a") GROUP BY 1
answer.assistantText: This shows the total new COVID deaths in the US for the last full calendar year in the data, using the US deaths dataset (all states and counties, including unassigned records). I took "last year" to mean the calendar year before the year of the data's latest date.
